prompt: Use the uploaded image as the composition, pose, outfit styling, lighting, and geometric studio-background reference. Create an ultra-realistic full-body professional editorial portrait of an adult man approximately 28–35 years old. Position him standing casually against an artistic three-dimensional geometric wall, facing the camera with a warm, confident natural smile. Give him a clean, neat low haircut with short dark hair, a natural hairline, smoothly tapered sides, and polished professional grooming. Keep his facial features mature and masculine with realistic skin texture and natural proportions. Dress him in a premium deep burgundy-red bomber jacket with a subtle satin finish, worn open over a fitted plain black crew-neck T-shirt. Pair it with tailored slim-fit black trousers and spotless minimalist white leather sneakers. Keep the styling modern, sophisticated, and understated. No necklace, chain, earrings, rings, or visible jewelry. Recreate the relaxed pose: both hands naturally tucked into the trouser pockets, shoulders relaxed, body slightly leaning against the wall, with one leg crossed casually in front of the other at the ankles. Maintain direct eye contact with the camera and an approachable, confident expression. Build the background from large interlocking three-dimensional rectangular blocks and architectural cubes in alternating deep burgundy, matte white, and charcoal black. Arrange the blocks at different depths to create dramatic recesses, projecting sections, strong geometric lines, and a sophisticated contemporary studio-installation effect. Use a polished dark-gray concrete floor with subtle natural reflections beneath the shoes. Illuminate the scene with soft professional studio lighting, producing clean facial highlights, gentle dimensional shadows around the geometric structures, realistic fabric texture, and controlled reflections on the bomber jacket. Shoot in a high-end commercial fashion photography style, approximately 50–85mm lens perspective, full-body vertical framing, eye-level camera angle, sharp focus on the subject, realistic depth, natural skin tones, crisp clothing details, balanced contrast, premium color grading, photorealistic textures, and 8K editorial quality.

promptZh: 参考上传图片的构图、姿势、服装造型、光影及几何摄影棚背景。创作一张超写实的全身专业时尚杂志风格肖像，主体为 一名 28 至 35 岁左右的成年男性。让他随意地站立在具有艺术感的立体几何墙前，面向镜头，露出温暖、自信且自然的微笑。发型为干净利落的短发，发际线自然，两侧修剪平整，整体形象干练专业。面部特征成熟阳刚，皮肤纹理真实，比例自然。身穿 一件带有细腻缎面光泽的高级深酒红色飞行员夹克，内搭一件修身纯黑色圆领 T 恤，敞开穿着。搭配修身剪裁的黑色长裤和一尘不染的极简白色皮革运动鞋。造型保持现代、精致且低调。不佩戴项链、链条、耳环、戒指或其他可见首饰。还原放松的姿势：双手自然插在裤兜里，双肩放松，身体微微倚靠在墙上，双脚脚踝处自然交叉。保持与镜头的直接眼神交流，表情自信且平易近人。背景构建参考 由深酒红色、哑光白色和炭黑色交替组成的巨大联锁立体矩形块和建筑立方体。将这些方块以不同深度排列，营造出戏剧性的凹陷、突出部分、强烈的几何线条以及精致的当代摄影棚装置效果。地面为抛光深灰色混凝土，鞋底下方带有细腻的自然倒影。场景采用柔和的专业摄影棚灯光，呈现清晰的面部高光、几何结构周围柔和的立体阴影、真实的织物纹理以及飞行员夹克上受控的反射光。采用高端商业时尚摄影风格，约 50–85mm 镜头视角，全身垂直构图，平视拍摄角度，主体对焦清晰，景深真实，肤色自然，服装细节锐利，对比度平衡，高级色彩分级，纹理写实，具备 8K 杂志级画质。
